name: Dockhand

items.name: Heft Crate
items.text:
Requirements The dockhand is adjacent to a crate

---
Effect The dockhand picks up a crate and heaves it up to 15 feet. Upon landing, the crate breaks open in a 5-foot burst. Each creature in the area takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage with a DC 13 basic Reflex save save, and the area is difficult terrain until cleared.

items.name: Swig
items.text: The dockhand Interacts to either draw a bottle of Alcohol or pick up a nearby unattended bottle of alcohol, then drinks the whole thing. For 1 minute, the dockhand gains a +2 item bonus to melee damage rolls and saving throws against fear but is Off-Guard.

text:
Working to load and unload cargo from ships, dockhands are considered unruly, but many stay focused and work hard until the job is done.

---
Society is built upon the backs of laborers.
